description: Source code for a Bluetooth Peripheral Object Transfer Service (OTS) example using Zephyr RTOS, implementing object management, connection handling, and advertising.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection establishment, logs success or failure.

methods.name: ots_obj_created
methods.description: Callback for when an OTS object is created, manages object pool and properties.

methods.name: ots_obj_deleted
methods.description: Callback for when an OTS object is deleted, updates object count.

methods.name: ots_obj_selected
methods.description: Callback for when an OTS object is selected.

methods.name: ots_obj_read
methods.description: Handles reading data from an OTS object, supports fragmented transmission.

methods.name: ots_obj_write
methods.description: Handles writing data to an OTS object.

methods.name: ots_obj_cal_checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum for an OTS object data.

methods.name: ots_init
methods.description: Initializes the Object Transfer Service, adds demo objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to initialize Bluetooth, OTS, and start advertising.
